# @dxtmisha/functional

> Comprehensive library of utilities, base classes, and Vue 3 composables for reactive web development.

Extends `@dxtmisha/functional-basic` with Composition API primitives, reactive API management (`useApiRef`), state singletons (`executeUse`), browser storage synchronization, and internationalization composables.

## Key Modules & Composables

- [executeUseGlobal / executeUseLocal / executeUseProvide](src/functions): Singleton factories for reusable service state and decoupled API management.
- [useApiRef / useApiManagementRef](src/composables): Reactive HTTP client composables with loading states, caching, pagination, search, and SSR hydration.
- [useStorageRef / useSessionRef / useCookieRef](src/composables): Reactive wrappers for persistent storage with automatic cross-tab synchronization.
- [useGeoIntlRef / useGeoUnitRef / t](src/composables): Locale-aware formatting for numbers, dates, currencies, units, and reactive translations.
- [DesignConstructorAbstract / DesignComponents](src/classes): Class-based base architecture for building component constructors with lifecycle management.
- [useMeta](src/composables): Reactive document title, Open Graph, and Twitter card synchronization.
- [computedAsync / computedEternity](src/functions): Async computed property helpers for Vue 3.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-types.md](ai-types.md): Public TypeScript declarations and signatures.
